model.title: Safe Beaches, Safe Swimmers Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jennifer Kiggans (R-VA)

summary.text: The bill would require federal agencies managing beaches and swimming areas to maintain adequate lifeguard staffing during normal operating seasons. If federal lifeguard shortages threaten to leave a beach unmonitored, the Department of the Interior could partner with local governments to provide lifeguards instead, with the federal government reimbursing local agencies for their costs. The requirement would not apply to temporary staffing gaps from things like employee leave.
